copy.tagline: 打造性能好又省电的移动游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发触屏手机游戏
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing touchscreen mobile games

howto.what: 在移动游戏相关讨论中,Claude 会应用这些原则:建议大尺寸触摸目标、节电与热管理、满足 iOS/Android 商店要求,并避免典型反模式。
howto.when: 当用户询问触摸输入、性能优化或应用商店上架等移动游戏开发问题时。

say.text: 帮我优化手机游戏的触摸操作,按钮应该多大合适?
say.note: 会给出触摸目标尺寸等设计建议。

say.text: 我的游戏耗电太快,有什么省电策略?
say.note: 得到电池优化和性能调校建议。

say.text: 上架 App Store 和 Google Play 前要准备什么?

howto.what_en: In mobile game discussions, Claude applies principles from this guide: touch-friendly UI, battery and thermal management, iOS/Android store requirements, and avoidance of common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask about touch input, performance optimization, or app store submission in the context of mobile game development.

say_en.text: Help me optimize touch controls for my mobile game. What size should buttons be?
say_en.note: Gives touch target size and design guidance.

say_en.text: My game drains battery too fast. What are some power-saving tips?
say_en.note: Provides battery and performance optimization advice.

say_en.text: What do I need to prepare before submitting to the App Store and Google Play?
